# Virginia Avunjian and Ashley Stirrup + Graham McNicoll
Date: 2026-11-19 | Duration: 36m

## Summary
The discussion established the onboarding and finance transition plan, with Virginia Avunjian leading the first 60–90 days before rolling off after one or two financial statements, while Zach Motz, Farrah Raagas, and Ali form the ongoing accounting and finance team. Priorities include moving fully to accrual accounting, improving month-end reporting, strengthening collections, and building a forecast for next year’s growth and burn outlook. The team generally targets closing books by the 15th, with board meetings preferably scheduled at least three weeks after quarter close. Open items include confirming Fondo’s contract end date and November close ownership, obtaining access to finance and payroll systems, deciding on tax-provider support, and resolving the accounting inbox structure. The company also discussed its subscription and CDN revenue model, commission processes, payroll across Rippling and Deel, the Pulley-to-Carta cap table migration, and a tentative move to Ramp for vendor payments.

## Keywords
Accrual accounting, Financial forecasting, Month-end close, Fondo transition, Ramp, Cap table migration
